review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: 6 retail bytes, 2 instructions, 1 block, 0 edges; candidate 1/0 at CFG 1.000.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: No ABI arguments: the routine takes void and reads only the static object.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: One constant: the address 0x00A70C88. No scale, mask, offset or rounding is applied.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Exactly one dword load from 0x00A70C88; no store, no bounds check, no indirect access. The 4-byte access width is the only proven fact about the object, and this native's file is its defining file.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: No call and no store: the only effect is the returned value, so there is no side effect to compare.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: One entry and one exit: the single ret at +5. No branch, no early return and no error path.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The body performs no floating-point load, store or arithmetic; it moves one integer value.
